label: AbiD system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiD-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder AbiD__AbiD profile and exemplified by the Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis KR5 pBF61 determinant whose abiD open reading frame confers an abortive phage infection phenotype with reduced plating efficiency, plaque size, and c2 phage burst size.
observations: AbiD branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiD genes, AbiD proteins, the pBF61 plasmid, the DefenseFinder AbiD__AbiD HMM profile, source database rows naming one AbiD locus, individual lactococcal phage host-range outcomes, unresolved AbiD triggers or arrest targets, and generic abortive infection systems.
